compiled_state.title: [llm-review dispatch]: deep-tier specialist emits Anthropic tool-use markup as literal text -> JSON parser rejects response with 'cannot parse as findings'
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** e1a8c8ca37b78b01385e210c70b2d2a90e78d158
* **CI run:** https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26692111267/job/78671149423
* **PR:** #482 (staged-1599924f2192-1780115111 → main)
* **Specialist:** deep-tier verification specialist (sonnet B per code-reviewer-deep-verification)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

llm-review specialists must emit a JSON findings document conforming to reviewer-findings.json schema (see plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md). Tool-use must either (a) be invoked via the LLM provider's structured tool-use API and resolved server-side before the JSON is produced, or (b) be absent entirely with the specialist working only from the diff and pre-loaded context.

#### Actual Behavior

Specialist returned a 15915-char response containing literal tool-use markup as text:

```
I will review this diff focusing exclusively on the **verification** dimension...
<function_calls>
<invoke name=\"bash\">
<parameter name=\"arguments\">[\"$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/dso\", \"verify-review-diff.sh\", \"$DIFF_FILE_PATH\"]</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name=\"bash\">
<parameter name=\"arguments\">[\"head\", \"-100\", \"$DIFF_FILE_PATH\"]</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
...
```

The dispatcher emitted:
`ERROR: LLM returned non-JSON response (length=15915); cannot parse as findings.`
`ERROR: llm-review found blocking finding(s) — 1 critical, 1 important`

The 'blocking findings' are spurious — they're synthesized from the parse failure path, not real review findings. Net effect: review fails (exit 1) blocking merge, but for an infrastructure reason, not real findings. Costs API tokens without producing reviewable output.

### 6. Logs / Repro

* See CI run linked above.
* Repro path: trigger any llm-review dispatch where the deep-tier dispatch reaches the verification specialist with a diff requiring tool use (large diff, multi-file review).
